edits.old: Code-review inference: For scheduled runs, OneUptime's example chooses resume only if the runner's current UTC hour is 08 and chooses pause otherwise. A morning scheduled run delayed into a later hour can therefore pause instead. The sample already accepts an explicit workflow_dispatch action; route scheduled actions from github.event.schedule rather than execution time. (medium confidence)
edits.new: GitHub documents that scheduled workflow runs can be delayed during periods of high load, and that a workflow with several cron schedules can tell which one fired through the github.event.schedule context. Deriving the action from execution time (for example, the current UTC hour) is therefore fragile for scheduled runs; routing on github.event.schedule is the more robust approach. (Code-review inference.) Sources: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows
